verdict.rationale: Neon documents branching as a core primitive with full API/CLI support (create/reset/restore branches), a first-party GitHub integration for automated per-PR branch workflows, TTL-based auto-expiring branches configurable via neon.ts, and a project-per-user/branch-per-PR pattern explicitly documented for CI/CD and platform automation at scale. The Neon API and CLI also allow scripted teardown, and MCP/agent tooling further supports automated branch lifecycle management. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on case study explicitly confirming a CI pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions) auto-creating/destroying a branch per PR end-to-end, and no direct quote from the GitHub integration docs describing PR-close teardown behavior.
